en.heading: Planning the March offsite
en.lede: {n} short questions to settle where we go, for how long, and what we must talk about.
en.purpose: Book the venue by the end of the month.
en.used: Each answer is saved under your name, and everyone with this page can see it. The people team reads them on Friday and books the venue.
en.how: Each question takes under a minute.

en.title: Two days, not three
en.body: Last year the third day was half empty: 14 of 38 people had left by lunch.
en.rec: Two days, Thursday and Friday, with the evening in between for dinner.

en.title: Where should we go?
en.body: Both fit the budget for 40 people in March. Somewhere else works too if it does.
en.rec: Turin: one train for most of us, and the venue holds the date until the 30th.

en.title: A moment worth repeating
en.body: Something from last year's offsite that you'd want again, as it happened: a session, a dinner, a conversation.
